title: Copy Data Between Companies in Business Central (2 Built-In Methods You're Probably Missing)

chapters.title: Introduction to copying data between companies
Master Data Management Setup - overview and configuration
Custom table example and demo setup
Master Data Management Setup - pull strategy demonstration
Configuration Worksheet method for copying data

features.name: Master Data Management Setup
features.description: A feature that allows pulling data from a source company to a target company using a pull strategy. Users can configure which tables and specific fields to synchronize, and validate fields in the target company.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have right now available in Business Central in 2025 in October 2025
caveats: Based on a pull strategy from target to source
Larger tables like customer prompt synchronization of related tables

features.name: Configuration Worksheet
features.description: A method for copying data between companies that was introduced as part of the rapid start methodology for populating new companies with data. Includes a Copy Data from Company action.
caveats: Triggered through process advance rather than job queues
Uses user-initiated action rather than background job queue processing

features.name: Configuration Packages
features.description: A data copy method mentioned as an alternative approach, but noted to have issues with data corruption on larger tables with many validations.
caveats: Can cause data corruption on bigger tables with many validations
Team chose to look for more stable solutions
